translation.title: Salicylic Acid Acne Tip Swab
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for the treatment of acne.
translation.usage: Apply it twice a day, in the morning and in the evening. Wipe the medicine off the part you hold with your hand before using it.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it or have had a hypersensitivity reaction to it, or if you have diabetes or a blood circulation disorder. Do not apply it around the eyes, on mucous membranes, or on areas with infection, inflammation, redness or irritation. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you have experienced allergic reactions to medicines or cosmetics (such as rash, redness, itching or dermatitis caused by lacquer), if you have kidney failure, if you are hypersensitive to propylene glycol or have had an allergic reaction to it, or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. If your symptoms do not improve after repeated use, stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. This medicine is for external use only. Follow the directed dose and schedule exactly. If you have festering (purulent) dermatitis, weeping (oozing) skin or erosion (raw skin), treat that condition first before applying this medicine. Take care that it does not touch skin other than the affected area. Take care that it does not touch the eyes, nose, mouth or other mucous membranes; if it accidentally gets into the eyes, rinse completely with plenty of water and follow a doctor's instructions. Be careful when applying it to a widespread affected area, as side effects occur more easily. If this medicine is accidentally swallowed, consult a doctor or pharmacist. If you are breastfeeding, do not apply it to the breast area. For children, use it under the supervision of a guardian, and do not apply large amounts to wide areas or use it for a long period in children. Adverse reactions such as rash, redness, erythema (red patches), itching, or a local irritation reaction where the medicine touches healthy skin may occur; if they do, stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Store at room temperature away from moisture and light, keep out of reach of children, keep away from fire, and close the cap tightly when not in use.
